description: This file provides wrapper functions for the configured-binding registry, ensuring built-in bindings are registered before delegating to raw registry functions. It acts as a public interface for runtime plugin conversation bindings that require approval.

methods.name: export function primeConfiguredBindingRegistry( primeConfiguredBindingRegistry
methods.description: Wraps the raw registry priming function, ensuring built-ins are registered before invocation.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBindingRecord( resolveConfiguredBindingRecord
methods.description: Wraps the raw function to resolve a configured binding record, with built-ins registered beforehand.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBindingRecordForConversation( resolveConfiguredBindingRecordForConversation
methods.description: Wraps the raw function to resolve a binding record for a conversation, ensuring built-ins are registered.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBinding( resolveConfiguredBinding
methods.description: Wraps the raw function to resolve a configured binding, with prior registration of built-ins.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBindingRecordBySessionKey( resolveConfiguredBindingRecordBySessionKey
methods.description: Wraps the raw function to resolve a binding record by session key, ensuring built-ins are registered.
